title: Power (Method)
hints: A method has a return type, a name and parameters: long power(int base, int exponent) { ... } (classic Java adds static in front)
Start with long result = 1; and multiply it by base, exponent times.
Don't forget to return result; at the end of the method.

mustContain.message: Write the method with this signature: long power(int base, int exponent).

mustNotContain.message: Use a loop: Math.pow is not allowed here.
